cmd: cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/original_out.txt 2>/tmp/orig_err.txt; head -5 /tmp/original_out.txt; wc -l /tmp/original_out.txt
echo MARKER_A; head -3 /tmp/original_out.txt; echo MARKER_B; wc -l /tmp/original_out.txt; echo MARKER_C
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite ".schema words" ".schema synsets" ".schema senses" "SELECT * FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index'"
cd /app && sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM words; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM synsets;"

cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "
SELECT
  w.wordid AS word_id,
  w.word AS word,
  t.total_synsets,
  t.total_senses,
  t.distinct_domains,
  t.distinct_posids,
  x.top_synsetid,
  x.top_cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.wordid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
) t
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = t.wordid
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT c.wordid, c.synsetid AS top_synsetid, c.cnt AS top_cnt
  FROM (
    SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM senses s
    GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
  ) c
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c2.wordid, c2.synsetid
    FROM (
      SELECT s2.wordid, s2.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM senses s2
      GROUP BY s2.wordid, s2.synsetid
    ) c2
    WHERE c2.cnt > (SELECT MAX(c3.cnt) FROM (SELECT s3.wordid, s3.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM senses s3 GROUP BY s3.wordid, s3.synsetid) c3 WHERE c3.wordid = c2

cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "
WITH ws AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses s
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
top AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, cnt
  FROM (
    SELECT wordid, synsetid, cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY cnt DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
    FROM ws
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  w.wordid AS word_id,
  w.word AS word,
  t.total_synsets,
  t.total_senses,
  t.distinct_domains,
  t.distinct_posids,
  x.top_synsetid,
  x.top_cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.wordid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
) t
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = t.wordid
LEFT JOIN top x ON x.wordid = t.wordid
ORDER BY t.total_senses DESC, t.total_synsets DESC, t.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
" > /tmp/fast2_out.txt 2>/tmp/fast2_err.txt; echo EXIT=$?; head -3 /tmp/fast2_o
